prompt: Create a Go map generator for a small arena-style level: one big central hub room with 2 smaller side rooms, connected by tunnels. The hub should have lots of platforms for vertical chasing. Use background tiles to make each room look different. Write it as a complete Go program that outputs a .tscn file.

assertions.text: Output .tscn has correct format: [gd_scene format=4], TileMapLayer node, PackedByteArray, correct tileset ext_resource
Map has 3 rooms: 1 large hub and 2 smaller side rooms
Rooms connected via tunnels or narrow passages
Hub has multiple vertical platforms for chasing
Background tiles vary per room (different atlas regions)
